parent_prereg: docs/studies/sr_support_arm_prereg.json (3255be0): sample, halves, support-arm and square-arm definitions, cost and pass bar unchanged; its 15-min primary stays a registered primary.

exit_families.a: hold to the 15:55 ET close (close of the bar starting 15:54)
exit_families.b: PRIMARY. target T = bottom of the nearest charted resistance block (unbroken bearish OB or bullish breaker) strictly above the entry price, among blocks known at the arm's decision close (point-in-time, last 3 per side). Exit when a bar's high >= T, filled at max(T, that bar's open). No resistance above -> hold to 15:55. Else 15:55 close.
exit_families.c: stop + target: stop = (support block bottom) x (1 - 0.001); for the support arm the touched block S, for square/control arms the nearest charted support block below the entry (highest top among support blocks with bottom < entry), none -> no stop. Stop fires when a bar's low <= stop, filled at min(stop, that bar's open); stop is checked before the target in the same bar. Target as in (b). Else 15:55.
exit_families.d: fixed holds of 60, 120 and 240 min after entry (close of the first bar starting >= H after the entry bar's open), 15:55 cap

entry: unchanged: the open of the bar after the decision close, for every arm and control
arms: support-touch arm (primary room >= 0.40%, no %R), square arm (E rows), and per support arm one same-hour random minute (seed 37, any minute in the same name-day and ET hour) as in the parent; per square arm one same-hour random minute (seed 41) as information
primary_exit: (b) only. Others are information (limits multiple testing).
pass: exit (b): in BOTH chronological halves (A 09-11..09-22, B 09-23..10-02): support mean gross - square mean gross on matched name-days > measured round-trip spread (mean gross - net of support entries = 20 bp under the 0.20% model), with >= 50 support arms per half. Report net, n per half, day-clustered t. Same-hour random control reported alongside. Any PASS = PENDING SKEPTIC REVIEW. The parent's 15-min primary is reported separately with its own verdict.
report: per half and per exit family: n, gross bp, net bp, vs square, vs same-hour random control, day-clustered t
